text:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-us-west-2. Rolling 5m = 14.8% (baseline 0.6%). alert_id=PD-31765, severity=high. Paging on-call.

alex: I see spikes on the gateway dashboard, tailing logs now. 502 and upstream timeouts.

paul: Confirming from logs: a lot of `prefix-kv` errors. Example from gateway log:
```
ERROR inference.gateway: upstream_timeout shard=shard-7 req_id=abcd123 status=502 elapsed_ms=3500
ERROR prefix-kv: checksum_mismatch key=prefix:abc123 shard=shard-7
```

maya: paging in. Are we seeing evictions or corrupt fetches?

alex: eviction rate shot up ~8x in the last 6m. Metrics: `kv.evictions/s` normal 12 -> 98. `kv.misses/s` also up.

sre-lead: Could be an eviction storm + a handful of corrupt entries causing downstream decodes to fail and cascade timeouts.

eva: Is it limited to one shard/host?

paul: Mostly shard-7 and shard-8 on nodes-g5-*. Other shards normal.

ops-bot: CC @k8s-deploys — node g5-07 restarted recently 25m ago, but no rollouts since.

alex: I can run a quick kv-scan on shard-7 for checksum errors. Running:`/opt/tools/kv-check --shard shard-7 --head 1000`

paul: FYI clients are seeing gateway 504s too (upstream slowness). If prefix cache returns bad payloads the decoder is hanging/retrying.

alex: Scan output: 14 keys with checksum_mismatch, sample:
```
key=prefix:usr_9832 checksum_expected=0x4f3a got=0x0000 flags=corrupt
key=prefix:ctx_44 ttl=0 evicted=true reason=memory_pressure
```

maya: OK — immediate mitigation ideas: 1) Blacklist shard-7 for prefix-cache reads (force bypass to origin), 2) Increase gateway timeouts temporarily, 3) Auto-failover requests to fallback model variant.

sre-lead: I like forcing bypass for reads from shard-7 so we avoid corrupt payload decoding. We should avoid writes until we understand root cause.

paul: Command to add bypass header in routing policy: `redwood-route set --region us-west-2 --match shard=shard-7 --add-header X-KV-Bypass=true`

alex: Applying bypass to shard-7 now.

oncall-bot: action_taken: routing adjust applied by alex at 3176543302.

alex: Patching gateway to treat X-KV-Bypass as authoritative and skip prefix lookup. Doing a small canary (10%) first.

paul: Canary logs look promising — 10% of traffic hits origin and error rate for that cohort is back to baseline.

eva: Rolling the bypass to 100% for shard-7.

oncall-bot: action_taken: routing adjust rolled to 100% at 3176543365.

maya: Immediate customer impact: increased 5xx dropped from 14.8% -> 3.2% in 7m. Affected customers: acct-42, acct-99, search-saas-prod (partial). Notifying CS for outreach.

customer-oscar: Confirming: we saw a spike and many retries, but traffic is recovering. Thanks.

sre-lead: Next steps: 1) Quarantine corrupt keys and mark for rehydration, 2) Investigate eviction root cause (memory pressure or bug in eviction algorithm), 3) Plan for in-place repair and safe re-enable of prefix cache, 4) Postmortem owner.

alex: I will collect `kv` debug dumps for shard-7 and run a full consistency check. Dump started: `kv-dump --shard shard-7 --out /tmp/dump-317654`

paul: Scheduling a rolling restart of kv-workers on shard-7 hosts to clear transient state after dump. Doing controlled restart 1 host at a time.

ops-bot: restart job submitted: kv-worker/shard-7/rolling-restart by paul.

maya: I'm taking on-call for the handoff window. Summary for night follow-up: routing bypass in place, customer impact reduced, mitigation stable. Please write short handoff note and attach dump path.

alex: Handoff note: mitigation=kv-read-bypass shard=shard-7 applied at 3176543365, customer-impact decreased. Dumps located at s3://redwood-dumps/317654-shard7.tar.gz. Avoid flushes until postmortem.

sre-lead: Paging policy: escalate to infra-eng if evictions reappear after restart.

maya: I'll monitor dashboards for next 3 hours, then coordinate postmortem. Assigning postmortem owner to alex.

paul: For the runbook, I'll add a new step to test checksum integrity during rolling restarts.

oncall-bot: incident_created: INC-3176543210 severity=high owner=alex link=https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-3176543210

alex: Thanks all. After we stabilize, we should consider a quota or circuit-breaker to limit blast radius of eviction storms.

maya: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up ticket for circuit-breaker + deeper root cause analysis.

sre-lead: Great work — keep this channel updated with any regression.

oncall-bot: closing note: monitoring for 1h.
